liveTargets.text: 回答後至少補一句具體細節（原因、感受、例子），再交回話題
同上 — 仍未穩定做到，繼續
先完整回答 → 一個具體細節 → 再交回話題（不要話沒說完就丟回去）
挑戰：60–90 秒講完 Stranger Things 故事，短句、不重啟（尚未驗收）
每個回答結尾完成一個簡短的交回問題 — 預設就用 What about you?
把完整想法說完，再切換成問單字／文法（學習模式排在對話之後）
補一個具體細節後就交回話題 — 給第二段解釋之前，先把發言權還給對方
先講完一個完整核心句，再補解釋或例子
澄清一次、確認一次，立刻回到閒聊
短答後加一個具體細節再交回
意思講清楚就停句，把回合交回對方
先給答案結構（路標句），再給支持細節
行為題第一句先講主點，之後才補背景
一次講完一個想法單位，完成後再接下一個
一句話一個完整想法 — 說完一句再加下一個細節或問題，不要邊講邊改

patterns.name: 回答太短就結束
patterns.zh: 只給一個事實就停，對方沒東西可接

patterns.name: 誤解不修復
patterns.zh: 對方明顯會錯意時沒有立刻澄清

patterns.name: 沒先回答就交回／交回沒說完
patterns.zh: 回答完沒交回話題，或問題/句子說一半放棄（Yeah, what about... / Have you ever...）

patterns.name: 句子重啟
patterns.zh: 邊講邊修、重複開頭或把問題重組好幾次，不整句重來（已成為目前最大痛點）

patterns.name: 轉場突兀
patterns.zh: 換話題沒有承接上一句（少一個 Thanks.）

patterns.name: 中途切換問英文
patterns.zh: 話題講到一半停下來問單字用法，打斷對話流（真實面試會很突兀）

patterns.name: 解釋太長沒交回
patterns.zh: 一個話題連講多層解釋，變成小型簡報，對方插不上話（義法料理比較）

patterns.name: 敏感話題框架
patterns.zh: 把族群和犯罪率連在一起問安全 — 職場紅線；要改問地區、時段、交通方式

patterns.name: 沒話題就要對方出題
patterns.zh: 話題枯竭時直接請對方想話題（Can you pick a topic?），真實場合對話會就此結束

patterns.name: 錯過收尾訊號
patterns.zh: 對方明顯要結束對話時沒跟著收尾，反而追問或重啟話題

patterns.name: 依賴逐字背稿
patterns.zh: 練習時反覆要求整段重唸來背稿，而不是練答案的結構

priorities.t: 一次一個想法，句子講完再接下一句
priorities.why: 句子重啟在 19 場新收錄中出現 14 場，壓倒性第一；面試答題先給路標句（There are two parts to that.）再展開

priorities.t: 複數與過去式 — 兩大文法黑洞
priorities.why: 複數一致已 14 場（two experiences／seven companies）、過去式已 11 場（worked／led／reviewed）；自介每一句都會踩到，優先修

priorities.t: 行為題第一句就鎖定故事
priorities.why: 09/30 固定資產好故事被追問兩次才出現 — 用 Sure. One example from audit comes to mind. 直接開場

errors.wrong: Can you repeat again?
errors.right: Sorry, I didn't catch that. / Could you say that again?
errors.rule: repeat 已含「再一次」，加 again 是贅字

errors.wrong: How's your weekend? / I work at Deloitte for three years / I review 20 reports
errors.right: How was your weekend? / I worked... / I reviewed...
errors.rule: 已完成的事一律過去式：經歷、昨天的事、剛做完的動作（worked／led／reviewed／majored in）

errors.wrong: The effect is so awesome.
errors.right: The sound and lighting effects were amazing.
errors.rule: 描述過去的體驗用 were，不用 is/are

errors.wrong: I'm so admire you.
errors.right: I really admire you.
errors.rule: admire 是動詞，前面不能加 am/is/are

errors.wrong: I've eaten for my lunch.
errors.right: I already had lunch.
errors.rule: 「吃過午餐了」的固定說法，不加 for my

errors.wrong: two slice of breads
errors.right: two slices of bread
errors.rule: bread 不可數：slices 加 s、bread 不加

errors.wrong: order double espresso / as auditor / table for three / a interview
errors.right: a double espresso / as an auditor / a table for three / an interview
errors.rule: 單數可數名詞前要加 a/an（母音開頭用 an）

errors.wrong: put into a fridge / put it into air fryer
errors.right: put it in the fridge / in the air fryer
errors.rule: put 要接受詞 it；家電用 the

errors.wrong: do exercise
errors.right: work out / I usually exercise after dinner.
errors.rule: 美式口語用 work out，或把 exercise 直接當動詞

errors.wrong: Normally, I usually grab coffee...
errors.right: I usually grab coffee...
errors.rule: normally 和 usually 同義，擇一即可

errors.wrong: mix with my whole milk
errors.right: mix it with whole milk
errors.rule: mix 要接受詞 it（指 espresso）

errors.wrong: I went to watch her movie. → "Odyssey."
errors.right: I went to see a movie called Odyssey. It was pretty interesting.
errors.rule: go see a movie 是固定說法；片名和活動放同一句，避免對方猜

errors.wrong: I think I will be good. / I think now I'm good.
errors.right: I think I'll be okay. / I think I'm ready now.
errors.rule: 預期面試表現用 be okay / ready / feel prepared，good 太模糊

errors.wrong: I'm gonna interview for a junior associate.
errors.right: I'm interviewing for a junior associate position.
errors.rule: interview for + 職位要加 position/role

errors.wrong: It's quite smooth.
errors.right: The drive was pretty smooth.
errors.rule: 描述通勤講 the drive / traffic，且用過去式

errors.wrong: What show do you watch lately?
errors.right: What shows have you been watching lately?
errors.rule: 「最近」的持續行為用現在完成進行式

errors.wrong: instant noodle
errors.right: instant noodles
errors.rule: 泛指泡麵這種食物用複數

errors.wrong: drug in campus
errors.right: drugs on campus
errors.rule: 校園裡固定用 on campus

errors.wrong: They gonna protect...
errors.right: They're going to protect...
errors.rule: gonna 前面仍要有 be 動詞

errors.wrong: How do this agent... / It fall off... / Berry cornbread win...
errors.right: How do these agents... / It falls off the bone. / Berry cornbread wins for me.
errors.rule: 主詞單複數要和動詞一致（第三人稱單數動詞加 s）

errors.wrong: The story is talking about...
errors.right: The story is about... / The show deals with...
errors.rule: 介紹劇情用 is about / follows / deals with

errors.wrong: in this March
errors.right: this March / in March
errors.rule: this + 月份前不加 in

errors.wrong: The burrito contains ground beef.
errors.right: The burrito has ground beef.
errors.rule: 講食物內容 has 比 contains 口語自然

errors.wrong: Mexican mix cheese
errors.right: Mexican-blend cheese
errors.rule: 起司名稱固定講法

errors.wrong: upcoming weekends
errors.right: this weekend
errors.rule: 指最近這個週末用 this weekend；複數指未來多個週末

errors.wrong: my community lobby
errors.right: my building's lobby
errors.rule: 公寓大廳講 building's lobby / apartment lobby

errors.wrong: However, ...（口語）
errors.right: But ...
errors.rule: 閒聊中 but 比 However 自然，However 太書面

errors.wrong: And down!
errors.right: And done! / Five minutes later, it's ready.
errors.rule: 「完成！」是 done 不是 down

errors.wrong: heat for five minutes
errors.right: heat it for five minutes
errors.rule: heat 要接受詞 it

errors.wrong: I'm a common...（開頭不明句）
errors.right: I'm more of a coffee person.
errors.rule: coffee or tea 這類二選一問題：I'm more of a ___ person

errors.wrong: get a coffee
errors.right: grab a coffee / grab a cup
errors.rule: 職場快速拿杯咖啡用 grab 更自然

errors.wrong: The reason why I go to there is because of the Universal Studio.
errors.right: I went there mainly for Universal Studios.
errors.rule: 過去的旅行用過去式；there 前不加 to；片名是 Universal Studios（有 s）

errors.wrong: This is the day that my girlfriend will receive her salary.
errors.right: My girlfriend gets paid this Friday.
errors.rule: 發薪的固定說法是 get paid

errors.wrong: Same as me. / The same is yours.
errors.right: Same here. / Mine was about the same.
errors.rule: 「我也一樣」就說 Same here

errors.wrong: busy go Monday
errors.right: It's been a busy Monday.
errors.rule: 描述今天過得如何用 It's been a ___

errors.wrong: I seen in Houston.
errors.right: I've seen that in Houston.
errors.rule: 現在完成式要有 have：I've seen；並補受詞 that

errors.wrong: a hint of smoky savory
errors.right: a hint of smokiness / a smoky, savory flavor
errors.rule: a hint of + 名詞；形容詞要修飾 flavor 不能單獨掛著

errors.wrong: No problem, I will wait.
errors.right: No problem. I'm happy to wait.
errors.rule: 餐廳等位用 I'm happy to wait 比 I will wait 自然

errors.wrong: a Mexican restaurant, who is operated by...
errors.right: a Mexican restaurant that is run by a well-known Mexican chef
errors.rule: 餐廳是物，關係代名詞用 that/which（who 只用於人）；口語用 run by 不用 operated by

errors.wrong: you can easily access to seafood
errors.right: you can easily access seafood / you have easy access to seafood
errors.rule: access 當動詞直接接受詞；名詞用法才是 have access to

errors.wrong: those type of dish / 80 degree / two experience / seven company / 4 dollar
errors.right: those types of dishes / 80 degrees / two experiences / seven companies / four dollars
errors.rule: 數字大於 1、those、any（泛問）後面都要複數

errors.wrong: It's a little bit stuck.
errors.right: Traffic was a little backed up. / I got stuck in traffic.
errors.rule: 塞車是 traffic backed up；stuck 描述人或車（I was stuck in traffic）

errors.wrong: 300 restaurants joining the restaurant week
errors.right: around 300 restaurants are participating in Restaurant Week
errors.rule: 參加活動的標準說法是 participate in / take part

errors.wrong: enjoy this restaurant with a good price
errors.right: try the restaurant at a good price
errors.rule: 價格用 at a good price，不用 with

errors.wrong: However, in French, ...
errors.right: in France / when it comes to French cuisine
errors.rule: France 是國家、French 是形容詞（法國菜可說 French cuisine）

errors.wrong: I don't know when, when is the specific time, but I know it's gonna open.
errors.right: I'm not sure exactly when it's opening, but I heard it's coming soon.
errors.rule: 用 coming soon，避免重複的間接問句結構

errors.wrong: In St. Louis is snows every winter.
errors.right: In St. Louis, it snows every winter.
errors.rule: 天氣句需要虛主詞 it

errors.wrong: I've been to there once.
errors.right: I've been there once.
errors.rule: there 是副詞，前面不加 to

errors.wrong: any plan for upcoming holidays
errors.right: any plans for the upcoming holidays
errors.rule: 泛問計畫用複數 plans

errors.wrong: three days vacation
errors.right: a three-day weekend / three days off
errors.rule: 連假是 long weekend；vacation 指較長的休假

errors.wrong: Is there any words to try?
errors.right: Are there any other foods I should try?
errors.rule: 類別是食物（foods/dishes）不是 words；複數配 Are

errors.wrong: Did anything fun happened?
errors.right: Did anything fun happen?
errors.rule: did 之後動詞用原形

errors.wrong: My girlfriend has already get off work.
errors.right: My girlfriend just got off work.
errors.rule: has/have 之後用過去分詞；這裡用 just got 更自然

errors.wrong: People are hard to focus on the long video.
errors.right: It's hard for people to focus on long videos.
errors.rule: 表達困難用 It is hard for + 人 + to V

errors.wrong: I will watch a TV show or scrolling my phone.
errors.right: I watch a show or scroll on my phone.
errors.rule: or 連接的動詞形式要平行

errors.wrong: How was your plan for dinner?
errors.right: What's your plan for dinner? / What are you doing for dinner?
errors.rule: 問計畫用 what，不用 how

errors.wrong: heat the pot to the median heat
errors.right: heat the pot over medium heat
errors.rule: 火候是 medium（median 是統計中位數）；介系詞用 over

errors.wrong: when it come to boil
errors.right: once it comes to a boil
errors.rule: 固定用語 come to a boil，a 不能省

errors.wrong: Pick it up from my left off.
errors.right: I picked up where I left off.
errors.rule: 固定用語 pick up where you left off＝從上次停的地方繼續

errors.wrong: I didn't know the project was delayed... I will check it out and circle back to you.
errors.right: Oh, I didn't realize the project was delayed. Thanks for the heads-up. I'll look into it and circle back with you.
errors.rule: 先接 Thanks for the heads-up；了解情況用 look into it，之後回覆用 circle back with you（不是 to）

errors.wrong: I will make sure the presentation become more precise.
errors.right: Sure, I'll make the presentation more concise and go through it carefully.
errors.rule: make sure 後面主詞 it 要配 becomes；簡報用 concise（精簡），precise 比較適合數據或用詞

errors.wrong: eat outside（指上館子）
errors.right: eat out
errors.rule: 上餐廳吃是 eat out；eat outside 是在戶外吃

errors.wrong: shop the grocery / groceries shopping / go buying grocery
errors.right: go grocery shopping / get groceries
errors.rule: 買菜固定說 go grocery shopping 或 get groceries

errors.wrong: Why you are so nasty? / How to spell Merlot? / what you're up to
errors.right: Why are you...? / How do you spell...? / What are you up to?
errors.rule: 直接問句要把助動詞放主詞前

errors.wrong: I will get off bed... I will cook breakfast（講日常作息）
errors.right: I get up. I make breakfast.
errors.rule: 描述固定習慣與作息用簡單現在式，不用 will

errors.wrong: rigour in number
errors.right: rigor with numbers / attention to detail
errors.rule: 對數字嚴謹用 with；面試更常說 attention to detail

errors.wrong: it's quite usual / It's uh usual dinner
errors.right: It's pretty normal (for me).
errors.rule: 形容平凡的一天／一餐用 pretty normal

errors.wrong: Let's go, let's get it.（進面試前）
errors.right: I'm ready. Let's do it. / Let's head in.
errors.rule: 進場用 let's do it / head in，let's get it 像喊口號

errors.wrong: I have been to Thailand for five times
errors.right: I've been to Thailand five times.
errors.rule: 次數直接接數字，for 只用於時間長度

errors.wrong: I want to lose my weight
errors.right: I want to lose weight.
errors.rule: lose weight 固定說法不加所有格

errors.wrong: fulfill our eager to Japanese food
errors.right: satisfy our craving for Japanese food
errors.rule: 想吃某食物用 craving for

errors.wrong: a Argentina sauce name Chimichurri
errors.right: an Argentinian sauce called chimichurri
errors.rule: 國家用形容詞（Argentinian），介紹名稱用 called

errors.wrong: I don't think I am get used to those ham
errors.right: I'm not used to those kinds of ham.
errors.rule: 已習慣＝be used to；變習慣的過程才用 get used to

errors.wrong: it tastes like a stinky socks
errors.right: It tastes kind of funky to me.
errors.rule: 職場閒聊形容怪味用 kind of funky 較委婉

errors.wrong: I hate client changing the number
errors.right: I hate it when clients change the numbers.
errors.rule: 反覆惱人的事用 I hate it when ＋子句

errors.wrong: pick out my girlfriend
errors.right: pick up my girlfriend
errors.rule: 開車接人用 pick up；pick out 是挑選

errors.wrong: I can easily repair my laptop（送修）
errors.right: I could get my laptop repaired easily.
errors.rule: 請別人修用 get it repaired

errors.wrong: I don't know red wine very much
errors.right: I don't know much about red wine.
errors.rule: 不熟某主題固定說 not know much about

errors.wrong: Perfect to pair with with steak
errors.right: It pairs well with steak.
errors.rule: 餐酒搭配固定說 X pairs well with Y

errors.wrong: only myself on the car
errors.right: just me in the car
errors.rule: 人在車裡用 in the car，不用 on

errors.wrong: I'm so starving
errors.right: I'm starving.
errors.rule: starving 本身已極度飢餓，不加 so

errors.wrong: me and my girlfriend have watched this film
errors.right: My girlfriend and I watched this movie.
errors.rule: 當主詞用 My girlfriend and I

errors.wrong: I don't take bus
errors.right: I don't take the bus.
errors.rule: 搭大眾運輸固定說 take the bus

errors.wrong: It's about two hour drive（講每天花多久）
errors.right: I spend about two hours driving every day.
errors.rule: 投入的總時間用 spend ＋時間＋ V-ing

errors.wrong: catch up some errands
errors.right: catch up on some errands / run some errands
errors.rule: 處理雜事固定說 run errands 或 catch up on

errors.wrong: Don't you think to quit
errors.right: Wouldn't you think about quitting?
errors.rule: think about / consider 後接 V-ing

errors.wrong: I'm thinking I'm thinking going to New Orleans
errors.right: I'm thinking of going to New Orleans.
errors.rule: 考慮做某事用 think of/about + V-ing

errors.wrong: I still not understand
errors.right: I still don't understand.
errors.rule: 現在式否定用 don't ＋原形

errors.wrong: Do you believe Ghost
errors.right: Do you believe in ghosts?
errors.rule: 相信某種存在用 believe in ＋複數

errors.wrong: do you have heard ghost story
errors.right: Have you heard any ghost stories?
errors.rule: 現在完成疑問句直接 Have you ＋過去分詞

errors.wrong: get off bed
errors.right: get out of bed / get up
errors.rule: 起床固定說 get out of bed 或 get up

errors.wrong: reserve decent restaurant
errors.right: make a reservation at a nice restaurant
errors.rule: 訂位說 make a reservation at；reserve a restaurant 像包場

errors.wrong: a cup of nice coffee
errors.right: a nice cup of coffee
errors.rule: 形容詞放在單位詞組前：a nice cup of

errors.wrong: the feeling you will add in a omelette
errors.right: the filling you put in an omelet
errors.rule: 餡料是 filling，不是 feeling

errors.wrong: How many cottage cheese should I put
errors.right: How much cottage cheese should I use?
errors.rule: 不可數食物用 how much

errors.wrong: it's my first time taste them
errors.right: It's my first time trying it.
errors.rule: first time 後接 V-ing；嘗食物用 try

errors.wrong: I don't quite understand what are you talking
errors.right: I don't quite understand what you're talking about.
errors.rule: 間接問句用直述語序

errors.wrong: Traffic I stuck in the traffic jam
errors.right: I'm stuck in traffic.
errors.rule: 描述現況要有 be 動詞：be stuck in traffic

errors.wrong: What worth to visit in Munich
errors.right: What's worth visiting in Munich?
errors.rule: worth 後接 V-ing，不接 to V

errors.wrong: nothing special, just take it easy（形容工作日）
errors.right: It's been a pretty easy day.
errors.rule: 形容工作量用 an easy/quiet day；take it easy 是刻意放鬆

errors.wrong: I don't want there's too much smoke
errors.right: I don't want there to be too much smoke.
errors.rule: want 後面用 there to be

errors.wrong: It is really little too rare
errors.right: It's a little too rare.
errors.rule: 固定句型 a little too ＋形容詞

errors.wrong: ice latte
errors.right: iced latte
errors.rule: 冰飲固定說 iced（iced latte / iced coffee）

errors.wrong: is really hard to chewy
errors.right: It's really hard to chew.
errors.rule: to 後接原形動詞 chew；chewy 是形容詞

errors.wrong: I would like uh replace fries with salad
errors.right: Can I get a salad instead of fries?
errors.rule: 換配菜最簡單說 instead of

errors.wrong: the traffic is a little bit busy
errors.right: Traffic is a little heavy today.
errors.rule: 車流量搭配 heavy，不說 busy

errors.wrong: I just take the fastest road
errors.right: I just take the fastest route.
errors.rule: 導航選的路線用 route

errors.wrong: this air fryer doesn't fit my need
errors.right: It doesn't really meet my needs.
errors.rule: 固定搭配 meet my needs

errors.wrong: I'm calling for make a reservation（剪髮）
errors.right: I'd like to make an appointment.
errors.rule: 剪髮、看診用 appointment；餐廳才用 reservation

errors.wrong: today is so tired
errors.right: I'm so tired today.
errors.rule: 人用 tired；造成疲累的事才用 tiring

errors.wrong: I have a full-time experience
errors.right: I have full-time experience.
errors.rule: experience 泛指經驗時不可數、不加 a

errors.wrong: before take a sleep
errors.right: before going to sleep
errors.rule: before 後接 V-ing；睡覺說 go to sleep

errors.wrong: how do I set me apart?
errors.right: How do I set myself apart?
errors.rule: 主詞受詞同一人用反身代名詞 myself

errors.wrong: I don't want to take effort to memorize it
errors.right: I don't want to put in the effort to memorize it.
errors.rule: 固定搭配 put in the effort

errors.wrong: I don't want to be declined
errors.right: I don't want to be rejected.
errors.rule: 求職被拒用 rejected，decline 是婉拒邀約

errors.wrong: I really excited to know more about company
errors.right: I'm really excited to learn more about the company.
errors.rule: be ＋形容詞不能省 be；了解公司用 learn more about

errors.wrong: good fit to the company
errors.right: a good fit for the company / for the role
errors.rule: 談適配度固定用 fit for

errors.wrong: My mentor didn't agree what I said
errors.right: My mentor didn't agree with my assumption.
errors.rule: agree with ＋人／想法，agree that ＋子句

errors.wrong: So evidence is the important
errors.right: So evidence is important.
errors.rule: be ＋形容詞前不加 the

errors.wrong: graduated from Soochow University majoring Accounting
errors.right: graduated with a degree in accounting
errors.rule: major in ＋科系，或 a degree in ＋科系

errors.wrong: I had a opportunity to exposure to financial reporting
errors.right: I had the opportunity to gain exposure to...
errors.rule: opportunity to ＋動詞；exposure 要配 gain

errors.wrong: to be more close to the number
errors.right: to get closer to the numbers
errors.rule: 比較級用 closer，不說 more close

errors.wrong: a very potential platform for me to growth
errors.right: a strong platform for me to grow
errors.rule: grow 是動詞、growth 是名詞

errors.wrong: a handmade coffee
errors.right: a homemade coffee / coffee I made at home
errors.rule: 在家做的說 homemade；handmade 是手工藝品

errors.wrong: How should I gain this job
errors.right: How can I position myself well for this job?
errors.rule: 求職說 position myself / make a strong case

errors.wrong: adjusted entry
errors.right: adjusting entry
errors.rule: 會計調整分錄的標準說法是 adjusting entry

errors.wrong: the team I will be work with
errors.right: the team I'd be working with
errors.rule: would be ＋ V-ing 描述未來共事關係

errors.wrong: what do you enjoy the most during work in here
errors.right: What do you enjoy most about working here?
errors.rule: enjoy most about ＋ V-ing 固定句型

errors.wrong: I'm fear of speaking up early
errors.right: I sometimes hesitate to speak up early.
errors.rule: fear 不當形容詞；面試說 hesitate to 更得體

errors.wrong: I didn't well prepare
errors.right: I didn't prepare well. / I wasn't well prepared.
errors.rule: 副詞 well 放動詞後，或 be well prepared

phrases.en: Sorry, I didn't catch that.
phrases.zh: 最常用的「沒聽清楚」— 取代 repeat again

phrases.en: Could you say that again?
phrases.zh: 請對方再說一次

phrases.en: Sorry, could you repeat the last part?
phrases.zh: 指明是「最後一段」沒聽到

phrases.en: Sorry, what do you mean by 'go-to'?
phrases.zh: 針對特定字詞問意思

phrases.en: The drive was pretty smooth.
phrases.zh: 通勤順利的標準回答

phrases.en: I left a little early just in case.
phrases.zh: 補一句細節：提早出門以防萬一

phrases.en: Traffic wasn't too bad this morning.
phrases.zh: 今早車流還好

phrases.en: Is traffic usually this light around here?
phrases.zh: 交回話題的好問題

phrases.en: I'm a little nervous, but I feel prepared.
phrases.zh: 緊張但準備好了

phrases.en: It's a big step, but I'm excited to get started.
phrases.zh: 回應「這是一大步」時，加入情緒往前推

phrases.en: Is it usually pretty busy here in the mornings?
phrases.zh: 把話題交回去的問題

phrases.en: Got anything fun planned this weekend?
phrases.zh: 最自然的週末開場問句

phrases.en: What are you up to this weekend?
phrases.zh: 同上的變化型

phrases.en: I'll probably just catch up on rest. Nothing too wild.
phrases.zh: catch up on rest＝補眠；nothing too wild＝沒特別安排

phrases.en: Are you just going to take it easy?
phrases.zh: take it easy＝放鬆不排行程

phrases.en: Thanks. How was your weekend?
phrases.zh: 先承接上一句（Thanks）再換話題 — 轉場關鍵字

phrases.en: I already had lunch. I had ___ with ___.
phrases.zh: 吃過了＋內容的句型

phrases.en: That sounds cozy. Do you usually eat a light lunch?
phrases.zh: 回應對方的簡單午餐

phrases.en: What's your go-to lunch?
phrases.zh: go-to＝最常選的、口袋名單

phrases.en: What do you usually put in it?
phrases.zh: 問食物內容

phrases.en: That's a solid combo.
phrases.zh: 稱讚食材搭配

phrases.en: Can't forget the cheese. That ties it all together.
phrases.zh: tie it all together＝讓整體更完整

phrases.en: Have you watched anything good lately?
phrases.zh: 問影集的萬用開場

phrases.en: That sounds interesting. What's it about?
phrases.zh: 接對方提到的影集

phrases.en: It's about... / It follows... / The show deals with...
phrases.zh: 介紹劇情的三個句型

phrases.en: Did it feel more like a drama or an action show?
phrases.zh: 不能只答 yes/no 的好問題

phrases.en: Would you recommend it?
phrases.zh: 收尾追問

phrases.en: I went to see a movie called ___. It was pretty interesting.
phrases.zh: 活動＋片名＋反應，一句講完

phrases.en: I can see why it pulled you in.
phrases.zh: pull you in＝讓人入坑

phrases.en: This Houston heat is brutal.
phrases.zh: 抱怨熱的自然說法

phrases.en: The humidity is the real kicker, right?
phrases.zh: the real kicker＝最要命的部分

phrases.en: A movie might be the perfect choice in this weather.
phrases.zh: 天氣→電影的轉場

phrases.en: Maybe you could go for a walk after it cools down.
phrases.zh: after it cools down＝等涼一點

phrases.en: I usually work out after dinner. What about you?
phrases.zh: 先回答＋再交回的標準示範

phrases.en: Do you usually go in the morning, or do you squeeze it in after work?
phrases.zh: squeeze it in＝忙碌中擠出時間

phrases.en: That's impressive. I could never work out before work.
phrases.zh: 完整版稱讚：評價＋個人反應

phrases.en: Speaking of ...
phrases.zh: 從對方話題接到自己經驗 — S3 用得很好

phrases.en: That reminds me...
phrases.zh: 想到相關的事

phrases.en: By the way...
phrases.zh: 順帶一提

phrases.en: Since we're talking about shows...
phrases.zh: 順著目前主題延伸

phrases.en: That must have been incredible. What was the best part?
phrases.zh: 回應別人的精彩經驗＋追問

phrases.en: That sounds intense.
phrases.zh: 聽起來很刺激／很硬

phrases.en: It must have felt really immersive.
phrases.zh: immersive＝身歷其境

phrases.en: It was really nice talking to you.
phrases.zh: 比 nice to talk to you 更自然

phrases.en: Have a good one.
phrases.zh: 輕鬆道別

phrases.en: Good luck in there.
phrases.zh: 對要進面試／會議的人說

phrases.en: Thanks—I appreciate it.
phrases.zh: 回應對方的鼓勵

phrases.en: What about you?
phrases.zh: 最短、永遠可用的交回問題 — 要說完整，不要 Yeah, what about... 就斷掉

phrases.en: Do you work out too?
phrases.zh: 具體版交回問題（運動話題）

phrases.en: Are you a coffee person?
phrases.zh: 具體版交回問題（咖啡話題）

phrases.en: Hang on, let me finish my thought.
phrases.zh: 被打斷時禮貌保住發言權

phrases.en: I'm definitely more of a coffee person.
phrases.zh: 回答 coffee or tea 的直接開場

phrases.en: There's free coffee in the lobby, so I usually grab a cup after my workout.
phrases.zh: 細節句：免費咖啡＋運動後喝

phrases.en: What do you usually get?
phrases.zh: 問對方常點什麼

phrases.en: It helps me unwind after the day.
phrases.zh: unwind＝放鬆 — 晚上運動的好理由

phrases.en: What are you looking forward to this weekend?
phrases.zh: 比 any plans 更有溫度的週末問句

phrases.en: I caught up on some errands and relaxed.
phrases.zh: errands＝雜事；週末沒特別安排時的萬用回答

phrases.en: What's one place you'd love to visit again?
phrases.zh: 旅遊話題開場

phrases.en: What's your favorite city you've been to?
phrases.zh: 問最喜歡的城市

phrases.en: What stood out to you the most?
phrases.zh: stood out＝印象最深 — 旅遊/經驗的萬用追問

phrases.en: What kind of music do you usually listen to?
phrases.zh: 音樂話題開場

phrases.en: Have you been to any concerts recently?
phrases.zh: 延伸問句

phrases.en: It's been a busy Monday.
phrases.zh: 描述今天過得如何的標準句

phrases.en: Same here.
phrases.zh: 「我也一樣」— 取代 same as me

phrases.en: What time do you get off work?
phrases.zh: get off work＝下班

phrases.en: Are you heading home after this?
phrases.zh: 下班話題的自然延伸

phrases.en: Do you have a table for two?
phrases.zh: 進門第一句

phrases.en: Can you put us on the waitlist?
phrases.zh: 排隊候位

phrases.en: How long is the wait?
phrases.zh: 問要等多久

phrases.en: How many parties are ahead of us?
phrases.zh: parties＝組客人，問前面還有幾組

phrases.en: No problem. I'm happy to wait.
phrases.zh: 比 I will wait 自然的等位回應

phrases.en: The brisket is incredibly tender, with a rich smoky flavor and just a hint of spice.
phrases.zh: 口感＋風味＋一點辣 — BBQ 描述模板

phrases.en: melt-in-your-mouth / fall-off-the-bone
phrases.zh: 入口即化／骨肉分離 — 口感詞

phrases.en: I'm starving. I think I need to grab a burger.
phrases.zh: 比 I'm so hungry 生動，還順便開話題

phrases.en: Thanks so much for your help. I really appreciate it.
phrases.zh: 對服務人員/維修人員道謝

phrases.en: Traffic was a little backed up, but not terrible.
phrases.zh: backed up＝塞車的標準說法

phrases.en: It added about fifteen minutes to my commute.
phrases.zh: 補細節：多花了 15 分鐘

phrases.en: Houston Restaurant Week is going on right now—around 300 restaurants are participating.
phrases.zh: 兩句講完餐廳週，記得用 participating

phrases.en: Have you looked at any of the menus?
phrases.zh: 介紹完活動的收尾問句

phrases.en: Any spot on your list you are thinking of checking out?
phrases.zh: 問對方口袋名單

phrases.en: I'm eyeing this little Italian place I've heard about.
phrases.zh: eyeing＝考慮中還沒決定

phrases.en: I'm curious to see whether it lives up to the hype.
phrases.zh: live up to the hype＝名不虛傳

phrases.en: To me, Italian food is more ingredient-driven, while French food is more technique-driven. Which one do you prefer?
phrases.zh: 比較公式：一個對比→一個偏好→交回問句

phrases.en: That's just my impression, though. / Either way, I'd happily eat both.
phrases.zh: 話題變太學術時的收尾句

phrases.en: I'm still getting used to the Houston heat.
phrases.zh: 新來的人聊天氣萬用開場

phrases.en: When does the weather normally start cooling down?
phrases.zh: 交回問題：什麼時候開始轉涼

phrases.en: My girlfriend and I are planning to drive to New Orleans over Labor Day weekend.
phrases.zh: 連假旅行計畫的完整說法

phrases.en: I've been once for a conference, but I didn't really get to explore.
phrases.zh: 去過但沒玩到 — 一句講完不重啟

phrases.en: What would you recommend for a first real visit?
phrases.zh: 請對方推薦

phrases.en: I've heard safety varies a lot by neighborhood. Are there any areas tourists should avoid at night?
phrases.zh: 中性安全問法：問地區與時段，絕不連結族群

phrases.en: Is it better to use rideshare after dark?
phrases.zh: 問交通方式

phrases.en: It really depends on where you are and when.
phrases.zh: 對方常用的回答，也可以自己用

phrases.en: I've heard of gumbo, but I'm not exactly sure what it is. Is it more like a stew, or more like a rice dish?
phrases.zh: 問陌生食物：提出具體假設讓對方糾正

phrases.en: Besides beignets, what other dishes should I try?
phrases.zh: 請對方推薦其他菜（dishes 不是 words）

phrases.en: If you want something with the same ___ feeling, ___ is great.
phrases.zh: 推薦類似作品的萬用句型

phrases.en: I'm really into slow-burn mysteries.
phrases.zh: slow-burn＝慢熱型劇情

phrases.en: Can you walk me through it?
phrases.zh: 請對方一步步解釋（食譜、流程都可用）

phrases.en: First... / Next... / Then... / Once it comes to a boil... / Finally...
phrases.zh: 一句一步驟的五個錨點

phrases.en: Let some of the fat render out of the beef.
phrases.zh: render＝把油脂逼出來

phrases.en: How was your day? Did anything fun happen?
phrases.zh: 晚餐散步問另一半的標準句（did＋原形）

phrases.en: I usually put on a show while I'm on the treadmill. It makes the workout go by a lot faster.
phrases.zh: 跑步機配影集

phrases.en: My girlfriend just got off work, so I should get going. It was nice talking to you.
phrases.zh: 理由＋行動＋道別的完整收尾

phrases.en: Thanks for the heads-up.
phrases.zh: 謝謝你提醒我。

phrases.en: I'll look into it.
phrases.zh: 我會去了解一下。

phrases.en: I'll circle back with you.
phrases.zh: 我之後再回覆你。

phrases.en: go through it carefully
phrases.zh: 仔細看過一遍

phrases.en: Pretty smooth, actually. There wasn't much traffic for once.
phrases.zh: for once＝難得一次，給對方反應點

phrases.en: It saves me about fifteen minutes, but it's around four dollars each way.
phrases.zh: 說明收費道路的取捨

phrases.en: I got spoiled during grad school—I was only seven minutes from campus.
phrases.zh: got spoiled＝以前太爽，帶出對比

phrases.en: My commute isn't that long on paper, but it adds up.
phrases.zh: on paper／adds up 描述累積起來很花時間

phrases.en: Took me about 50 minutes door to door.
phrases.zh: door to door＝全程時間

phrases.en: I drop her off at work every morning.
phrases.zh: drop off＝順路載人下車

phrases.en: Nice, that's a rare win around here.
phrases.zh: 對方說交通順／運氣好時的自然反應

phrases.en: You get the full spectrum.
phrases.zh: 形容從平價到高檔什麼都有

phrases.en: Nothing set, just keeping it light.
phrases.zh: 計畫未定時的自然說法

phrases.en: What kind of trip were you imagining?
phrases.zh: 對方提到目的地時追問旅行想像

phrases.en: What else have you been watching lately?
phrases.zh: 最省力的追劇交回問句

phrases.en: I'll move it up on my list.
phrases.zh: 被推薦後的自然回應

phrases.en: I'm really into horror, especially monster and supernatural stuff.
phrases.zh: be into ＋類型

phrases.en: We had a pretty food-heavy weekend.
phrases.zh: 概括週末的開場句

phrases.en: Sometimes doing nothing can feel really nice.
phrases.zh: 聊放鬆週末的回應

phrases.en: What's your go-to brunch order?
phrases.zh: What's your go-to ___? 萬用問句

phrases.en: For us, the weekend basically starts Friday night.
phrases.zh: 週末話題自然開場

phrases.en: What's your go-to cuisine when you eat out?
phrases.zh: 問對方外食首選

phrases.en: Is there anything milder you'd recommend?
phrases.zh: 一句話要到溫和口味的推薦

phrases.en: Can I get the six-piece combo, half white and half dark, with mashed potatoes and a Diet Coke? That's it, thanks.
phrases.zh: 速食點餐一句到底；收尾 That's it, thanks

phrases.en: That's a splurge for sure.
phrases.zh: splurge＝偶爾犒賞自己的高消費

phrases.en: Hi, table for three, please.
phrases.zh: 進門帶位固定句

phrases.en: Everything else is great, but the asparagus is a little tough.
phrases.zh: 先正面再禮貌反映問題

phrases.en: I asked for medium rare, but this seems a bit more done.
phrases.zh: 熟度過頭的反映句

phrases.en: Could you cook it a bit longer, please?
phrases.zh: 太生時請店家回鍋

phrases.en: Can I get a salad instead of fries?
phrases.zh: 換配菜最好記的句型

phrases.en: What's the wait for three?
phrases.zh: 問三位要等多久

phrases.en: Great, we'll head over.
phrases.zh: head over＝馬上過去

phrases.en: What's your house red?
phrases.zh: 問店家招牌紅酒最省力的問法

phrases.en: I don't know much about wine. What would you recommend?
phrases.zh: 背景一句＋請求一句

phrases.en: What red wine pairs well with steak?
phrases.zh: 牛排配酒標準問法

phrases.en: If you'd like something lighter, I'd steer toward the Pinot.
phrases.zh: 「要 X 就選 A」推薦句型

phrases.en: It tastes kind of funky to me.
phrases.zh: 委婉說味道怪

phrases.en: You can get the bread texture without all that cured meat funk.
phrases.zh: 「得到 X 又不用 Y」折衷句型

phrases.en: It starts sweet, then buttery and lightly savory with a gentle corn note.
phrases.zh: a ___ note＝吃得出的風味層次

phrases.en: What goes well with cottage cheese?
phrases.zh: 問搭配吃法：What goes well with ___?

phrases.en: That's when the version control chaos begins.
phrases.zh: 檔案版本滿天飛的輕鬆吐槽

phrases.en: I hate it when clients change the numbers at the last minute.
phrases.zh: I hate it when...＝抱怨反覆發生的事

phrases.en: One coffee at a time, honestly.
phrases.zh: 一次一步撐過一週；可換 one meeting/day at a time

phrases.en: It's been pretty steady today. Nothing too crazy.
phrases.zh: 形容平穩的一天

phrases.en: I'm probably just going to relax. I might go for a walk once it cools down.
phrases.zh: 短答後加一個具體細節

phrases.en: I actually like grocery shopping when I want to unwind. Then I usually cook something when I get home.
phrases.zh: 紓壓話題：兩個完整想法給對方鉤子

phrases.en: So basically, you're saying... / If I'm understanding you right...
phrases.zh: 複述對方重點，會議面試閒聊都通用

phrases.en: Anyway, what are you up to after work?
phrases.zh: 用 Anyway 收掉聊很久的話題再交回

phrases.en: By the way, random question...
phrases.zh: 預告要跳話題，降低突兀感

phrases.en: Yeah, you too. Nice talking to you.
phrases.zh: 對方說 Have a good one 時跟著收尾，別重啟話題

phrases.en: It was nice talking to you. I should get going.
phrases.zh: I should get going 比 I gotta go 更中性

phrases.en: Do you have a favorite go-to item?
phrases.zh: 問對方 Costco 必買清單

phrases.en: Could you scale and gut it, please?
phrases.zh: 海鮮櫃檯請店員去鱗去內臟；開生蠔用 shuck

phrases.en: Could I get a large iced matcha latte, half sweet, light ice, please?
phrases.zh: 一句講完甜度冰塊的完整點法

phrases.en: Is that like your usual order?
phrases.zh: 對方提到飲料時的自然追問

phrases.en: Hi, I'd like to book a haircut with Jason.
phrases.zh: 一句話完成指定設計師的預約

phrases.en: I've got some skirt steak marinating, but I haven't decided how to cook it yet. What would you do with it?
phrases.zh: 一個細節＋交回的標準示範

phrases.en: Are you thinking pan sear, or maybe tossing it on the grill?
phrases.zh: 幫對方二選一的問法

phrases.en: Give it a quick sear.
phrases.zh: sear＝表面快速煎上色

phrases.en: Let me say it another way.
phrases.zh: 發現對方沒聽懂時，換個說法再講

phrases.en: Let me think about how to phrase that.
phrases.zh: 面試中光明正大買思考時間

phrases.en: I'd break that into two parts.
phrases.zh: 邊整理結構邊買時間

phrases.en: I've got an interview next Thursday for a cost accountant role.
phrases.zh: 主動帶出面試話題

phrases.en: I started my career at Deloitte, where I spent three years in audit and built a strong foundation in financial reporting and internal controls.
phrases.zh: 自介開場：started→spent→built 穩定時間軸

phrases.en: There are two parts to that.
phrases.zh: 兩段式問題先給路標再答

phrases.en: A better example would be...
phrases.zh: 例子不合時導向更強例子

phrases.en: Sure. One example from audit comes to mind.
phrases.zh: 行為題第一句就鎖定故事

phrases.en: I'm moving from reviewing the accounting process to owning the accounting process.
phrases.zh: 審計轉會計的核心敘事句

phrases.en: I haven't owned that process directly yet, but I'm familiar with the underlying process from audit.
phrases.zh: 承認缺口一次，立刻轉可轉移經驗

phrases.en: My main responsibility was reviewing investment-property valuations for financial reporting.
phrases.zh: 經驗題第一句講做了什麼

phrases.en: One thing that caught my attention was that operating income grew faster than revenue.
phrases.zh: 引用研究但不下死因果結論

phrases.en: One thing that sets me apart is my three years of audit experience at Deloitte.
phrases.zh: 講自身優勢的句型

phrases.en: What would success look like in the first six months to a year?
phrases.zh: 問期望的高級問法

phrases.en: What are the biggest priorities for this role in the first three to six months?
phrases.zh: 問招募官的首選問題

phrases.en: Could you tell me a bit about the team I'd be working with?
phrases.zh: 注意 I'd be working with

phrases.en: What are the next steps in the process?
phrases.zh: 收尾必問，短而有自信

phrases.en: One thing I'm working on is speaking up earlier in meetings. Now I prep a few points ahead of time and share them early.
phrases.zh: 弱點題模板：真實弱點＋具體改善

phrases.en: Thank you for the offer. I'm really excited about the role. Is there any flexibility on the base salary?
phrases.zh: offer 階段談薪的合作式開場

phrases.en: Nice to meet you, Mr. Lai. Do you mind if I call you Walter?
phrases.zh: 面試開場禮貌確認稱呼

phrases.en: At least it's easing up a little.
phrases.zh: 壞狀況漸漸好轉（天氣、塞車、工作量）

replays.a: Hi, I'm Duncan. I started my career at Deloitte, where I spent three years in audit and built a strong foundation in financial reporting and internal controls. Later, I moved into valuation.
replays.note: 動詞固定 started→spent→built→moved，先穩住時間軸（全部過去式！）

replays.q: What motivated you to move from audit into finance?
replays.a: There are two parts to that. First, audit let me see how management made financial and operational decisions, and that made me want to move closer to the decision-making side. Second, audit gave me a strong analytical foundation, while valuation and equity research added modeling and forward-looking analysis.
replays.note: 先給路標句，每部分兩句內講完

replays.q: Tell me about a time a manager challenged one of your assumptions.
replays.a: At K Capital, my mentor challenged one of my revenue-growth assumptions because he thought it was too aggressive. I went back to the research, gathered more concrete evidence, and walked him through my reasoning. After discussing it, we adjusted the assumption together.
replays.note: 衝突→行動→結果，第一句就把情境講清楚

replays.q: Can you tell me more about your valuation work at Deloitte?
replays.a: My main responsibility was reviewing investment-property valuations for financial reporting. I reviewed appraisal reports and challenged key assumptions such as discount rates, growth rates, and comparable market data. Over three months, I reviewed around 20 reports covering roughly $30 million in assets.
replays.note: 責任→方法→規模，不要從背景鋪起

replays.q: Tell me about a time you found an unusual transaction.
replays.a: Sure. One example from my audit experience was when I found fixed assets that were already in use but were still recorded as prepayments. I confirmed the issue, discussed the financial-statement impact with the controller, and proposed the adjusting entry.
replays.note: 行為題第一句鎖定具體事件，不要先講通用流程、也不要反問要聽哪段

replays.q: （自介的轉職段落）Why did you leave audit?
replays.a: Those three years gave me strong exposure to financial reporting and how different businesses operate. But I realized I wanted to move beyond reviewing the numbers and work closer to the accounting process itself. That's what led me to graduate study and why I'm now interested in an in-house accounting role.
replays.note: 一句一個任務：經歷→領悟→下一步

replays.a: Everything's great, thanks. Actually, could I get a salad instead of the fries?
replays.note: 先回應再提需求；換配菜用 instead of

replays.q: 對方用了你聽不懂的俚語（如 bail）
replays.a: Sorry—does 'bail' mean cancel? ... Got it. I do that sometimes too. Do you usually work out after work?
replays.note: 問一次、確認一次，馬上回到閒聊，別變成多輪英文課

replays.q: （想問紐奧良治安）Is it safe there?
replays.a: I've heard safety can vary a lot by neighborhood in New Orleans. Are there any areas tourists should avoid, especially at night?
replays.note: 問地區／時段／交通；族群與犯罪絕不放同一句 — 職場紅線

replays.q: What's the difference between Italian and French cuisine?
replays.a: To me, Italian food is more ingredient-driven, while French food is more technique-driven. I usually prefer Italian because it feels more comforting. Which one do you prefer?
replays.note: 一個對比→一個偏好→交回，20 秒內講完

replays.a: I think short-form videos have shortened my attention span. After scrolling through Reels, even a one-hour episode feels like a commitment. Have you noticed that too?
replays.note: 三句法：主張→個人例子→交回

replays.a: It was a little backed up this morning, but not too bad. Do you usually take the same route?
Pretty relaxing. I caught up on some errands and just took it easy. What about you?
replays.note: 沒特別安排的週末萬用回答

replays.a: First, brown the ground beef over medium heat. Next, add the minced garlic and gochugaru. Then pour in the broth and bring it to a boil. Once it boils, add the soft tofu and let it simmer. Finally, crack an egg into the pot.

challenge.title: 90 秒自我介紹挑戰（面試版）
challenge.rule: 一句一個任務；講壞一句就停，講完那句再往下，不重啟整段
steps: Opening — "Hi, I'm Duncan. I started my career at Deloitte..."
Audit years — "...where I spent three years in audit and built a strong foundation..."
The turn — "I realized I wanted to move beyond reviewing the numbers..."
Grad school + valuation — "That led me to graduate study, valuation and equity research..."
Why this role — "Now I'm looking to own the accounting process in-house."

prep.target: 一句話一個完整想法；面試答題先給路標句，每部分兩句內講完
useToday: There are two parts to that.（兩段式答題路標）
Sure. One example from audit comes to mind.（行為題開場）
I'm moving from reviewing the accounting process to owning the accounting process.（轉職主軸句）
reminders: 複數（已 14 場）：two experiences、seven companies、four dollars
過去式（已 11 場）：Deloitte 經歷一律過去式 — worked、led、reviewed、majored in
緊張時買時間：Let me think about how to phrase that. / I'd break that into two parts.
句子講壞不要整段重啟 — 停，把這句講完，再開下一句
別再 can you repeat again（已 4 次）→ Could you say that again?
lastMissed: 行為題選例太慢：好故事被追問兩次才講出來（09/30）
練習時要求整段重唸背稿（10/01）— 練結構，不是背逐字
話題枯竭就要對方出題（08/14、08/20）— 口袋先備 3 個話題
